events.title: Halt & Restart
events.summary: A live prompting lab. Write it tight. If the model drifts, halt and restart. The point was a better result with less context, then a human finish — not a longer chat.
events.blurb: A live prompting lab. Write it tight. If the model drifts, halt and restart.

events.title: Unnatural Games
events.summary: One chessboard. One language model. The room plays as a single team: debate the move, vote, then hear the model explain itself. Bragging rights only. Free, on campus, no alcohol. Each night needs its own approval, so “Mondays” is the slot we are asking for, not a locked series.
events.blurb: The room plays one side. The model plays the other. Bragging rights only.
events.posterAlt: Unnatural Games poster, Ticket. Humans versus the model, 6:00–8:00 PM.
